note: POST /api/stego/benchmark through the whole stack (Rust core, Python image service, loopback HTTP); a fresh generated cover per transaction; alternating directions. profile-constrained host benchmark (raspberry_pi_5_cpu): the profile's limits were enforced on THIS host; these are not measurements from the profile's target hardware

raspberry_pi_5_cpu default (320x240 RGB).measurement_label: profile-constrained host benchmark (raspberry_pi_5_cpu): the profile's limits were enforced on THIS host; these are not measurements from the profile's target hardware

metric_kinds.cover_quality_score: heuristic coherence of the cover before embedding (not a steganalysis detector)
metric_kinds.detector_auc: offline evaluation only; not measured here

limitations: Host-simulation measurements on one machine; not representative of drone hardware. A resource profile such as raspberry_pi_5_cpu enforces that device's LIMITS on this host; it does not reproduce its speed, and these figures are not Raspberry Pi measurements.

Covers are procedurally generated images (no pretrained model). The cover quality score is a documented heuristic, not a steganalysis detector, and no generated cover or embedding is claimed to be undetectable.
Percentiles are null when fewer than 20 successful samples exist for the series.
PSNR/SSIM are null when undefined (e.g. identical images); they are never imputed.
Lossless PNG handoff only; no robustness to JPEG/resizing/filtering is claimed.
LSB-class methods are statistically detectable; no anti-steganalysis claim is made for any algorithm.
Per-patch selection is a static knowledge-base lookup (structured filters + BM25); no learned model is involved.
Algorithm names denote this repository's variants (e.g. additive HUGO approximation, custom STC matrices).
